CustosCross-platform local self-healing engine

Dependency-graph-driven failure detection, diagnosis and automatic recovery — implemented in Rust, local autonomy first, and a recovery only counts as successful when it passes health verification

Start reading
Phased implementation plan
Implementation brief

  • Dependency-graph-driven recovery

    Every resource can probe, diagnose, recover and verify; when dependencies are unmet, dependencies are recovered first according to policy.

  • Plugin-based capability encapsulation

    Plugins provide capabilities, while the Core Engine uniformly handles dependency coordination, execution permissions, recovery budgets, auditing and final verdicts.

  • Local autonomy first

    Detection, repair execution and persisted records keep working while the network is down; outbound notifications are retried after recovery.

  • Health verification rule

    A recovery only counts as successful when it passes health verification — never based on a command exit code alone.
